frame.ewar_note: Its baserunning is Baseball-Reference's (runs_br and runs_dp carried inside bWAR), a different frame from eBR and BsR.

bem_plus.reason: EBR_GATE.md part 12.1 records no BEM+ PASS

published.note: PUBLISHED, NOT COMPUTED HERE. FanGraphs' baserunning runs as MLB's feed publishes them, joined by MLBAM id; a traded player reads one season line. Since 2016 the served BsR is wSB plus Statcast's extra-base runner runs with no double-play part, so the feed's ubr and wGdp fields are not read.

ewar_join.basis: bat + pit, summed unrounded and rounded once

team_basis.label: baserunning
team_basis.note: The club MLB's transaction feed lists today, on the charts and in team totals, so a traded player's whole season counts for his new club. Rows with no club (0) are left out of team totals.

fields_note: rows are keyed; the history file's rows are positional by its `fields`

ewar_vintage.note: data/ewar.json rebuilds its live season nightly; completed seasons are frozen byte for byte and re-priced only by a hand build with the runbook cascade.

note: eBR is computed from MLB's play-by-play (tools/build_ebr.py); every count is official or from the runner record; BsR and wSB are FanGraphs' published values from MLB's feed; BRV, sprint speed and leads are Baseball Savant's. Descriptive: what happened this season, not a forecast.

repeat_copy.eBR: repeats less from one season to the next than FanGraphs' BsR on the same runners
repeat_copy.DP: repeats less from one season to the next than Baseball-Reference's double-play runs on the same runners
